> LEGOLAND Discovery Center Chicago might be aimed at kids, but let's face it, swashbuckling adventures with buccaneering pirates, ninjas, wildlife, and Jedi knights never really get old! With equal parts goofy fun, wild imagination, and creative brain training across a slew of themed rides and attractions, you'll rediscover your inner-kid pretty quickly!
